jobs_results.title: Cobol developer
jobs_results.description:
Ready for a new challenge? This job in Spain is the adventure you are looking for! Hays is an international recruitment company that has been active for more than 50 years and is currently present in 33 countries. Hays Spain is looking for French speaking Java developers for one of its clients based in Spain. Our client is a company present in more than 25 countries and has more than 45,000 employees worldwide. It is a world leader in digital transformation consulting for its clients. The Spanish branch of this company has more than 4,000 employees, so the only thing missing is you! They have offices in Madrid, Barcelona, Seville and Valencia. This consultancy firm offers its clients end-to-end solutions: from the creation of the platform, to all aspects of architecture design, to the implementation of the backend, frontend, mobility, etc. We are currently looking for a COBOL developer to join their team in Seville or Valencia. What we are looking for :

- French (B2 minimum)
- 2... years experience as a COBOL developer
- At the moment we are only looking for candidates who have the required documentation to work in Spain, i.e. European nationality or Spanish work permit.

What we offer:

- Hybrid modality
- Flexible hours
- Intensive days on Fridays and in August
- Flexible salary plan

Recruitment process : 1. Screening with Hays 2. Technical interview with client 3. Offer So if you are tempted by this challenge in Spain and if you correspond to the requested criteria, do not hesitate to send us your application

jobs_results.description: COBOL, Softwareentwicklung, Mainframe, Anwendungsbetreuung, IT, Batch Processing, Implementierung SOFTWARE DEVELOPER COBOL (F/M/D) | VSAM, CICS, VSE Full-time: 37.75h I Place of work: Fellbach near Stuttgart I Department: IT Applications I Hybrid work We are a private health insurance company with around 800 employees. For almost 100 years, we have shared a passion for people and health. As a mutual insurance company, our focus is on the health of our members. We value different perspectives and the experience of each and every employee. We treat each other as equals, are open with each other and have a culture of trust. Innovation and progress are important to us in order to cope with constant change and future challenges. To do this, we need strong personalities. Become part of SDK and help us continue our success story! THIS IS WHAT WE OFFER YOU: Flexible working hours (37.75 hours per week), 30 days' vacation, payment in accordance with the collective agreement for the insurance... industry (13.7 salary with special payments), capital-forming benefits, company pension scheme and health insurance Modern New Work environment with desk sharing, roof terrace, barista bar and company restaurant Very good accessibility - both by public transport and car, company bike offer Fitness and health area for free use, various health offers, such as lectures, check-ups, employee programs, team and company events Individual training opportunities, online learning programs, regular dialogue formats, e.g. with the Management Board or experts from the SDK team on various specialist topics So if you're looking for opportunities to do things better and continue to grow, you'll fit in perfectly with us! YOU BRING WITH YOU: Several years of professional experience in software development and maintenance with online and batch programs on IBM Mainframe (COBOL, VSAM, CICS, VSE) Good analytical skills Fun and enjoyment in familiarization and dealing with unknown software Experience with service-oriented architectures and developing interfaces to PC front-ends LOOK FORWARD TO: Further development (conception, estimation, implementation, testing and documentation) of business-critical, sometimes complex applications Error analysis and rectification as well as performance tuning and automation Optimization of build, test and delivery management processes (CI/CD) as well as development environments and standards After replacing the legacy system (HOST), there are further development opportunities, e.g. in the direction of Application Management or Business Analyst JOIN OUR TEAM: We look forward to receiving your application! Simply send it to us, preferably with your possible starting date and desired salary, to ******. Your contact person: Heiko Majewski, Senior Recruiter Süddeutsche Krankenversicherung a. G. Raiffeisenplatz 11 70736 Fellbach www.sdk.de
